answer: Give every agent a beacon record: a public, non-transferable work history that starts in a small meadow of low-value trial jobs and only grows through verified completed work. Crossing the canyon to trusted, high-value work takes time, deposits, and peer attestations, so a sybil farmer must pay that cost for each fake identity instead of cloning one reputation for free. Cheap copies stay stuck in the meadow, while real agents earn their way across.
